subject: Ensure Facet Labels Are Entirely Shown when Free Space Option Used

messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: Ensure Facet Labels Are Entirely Shown when Free Space Option Used
parts:
How can I ensure that all of the character of the facet labels will be displayed when I use space = "free" ? For example,

library(ggplot2)
data <- data.frame(group = rep(c("Heading", "Title"), each = 30),
                   x = c(rep('A', 30), rep(LETTERS[1:7], length.out = 30)),
                   y = rnorm(60))
                  
ggplot(data, aes(x, y)) + geom_boxplot() + facet_grid(. ~ group, scales = "free_x", space = "free")

Unless I make the plot undesirably wide, the word "Heading" isn't completely shown.

messages.author: 9c9b5f9c6aaa025d
messages.subject: Re: Ensure Facet Labels Are Entirely Shown when Free Space Option Used
parts: See the strip.text options to theme, http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/theme.html

library(ggplot2)
data <- data.frame(group = rep(c("Heading", "Title"), each = 30),
                   x = c(rep('A', 30), rep(LETTERS[1:7], length.out = 30)),
                   y = rnorm(60))
ggplot(data, aes(x, y)) + geom_boxplot() + facet_grid(. ~ group, scales = "free_x", space = "free”) + theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = rel(0.5)))
